﻿ ﻿ [font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]﻿ ﻿Update
[/size][/font]
Added [color=#9fc5e8][b]Only Winter[/b][/color] feature. You can set monsters to change only in winter.
This needs [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿.

If you don't need it, you can download previous version in [color=#ffe599]FILES - FILE ARCHIVE[/color].
Previous version doesn't need Generic Mod Config Menu.




[img]https://i.imghippo.com/files/UUZn1551ASU.png[/img]﻿
﻿ ﻿ ﻿[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]How to Install
[/size][/font]
﻿1. Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher.
2. Download mod then unzip into Stardew Valley/mods.
3. Run the game using SMAPI.
